entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The police are really here...[n]I saw 'em at the entrance.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I saw them too! They were[n]talking to the teachers!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That change of heart thing's[n]seriously amazing, huh!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I hope they don't find out[n]we're responsible...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm pretty sure we'll be fine.[n]There's no proof it was us.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But I mean, haven't rumors been[n]going around about how you guys[n]threatened Kamoshida?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This world's Kamoshida shouldn't[n]know anything about what actually[n]happened to him though.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We did what was right. Don't go[n]freaking out over some label.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Man, I really can't wait to[n]keep living this double life!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: All right, [fName]! We're[n]gonna be counting on you!
